text:
emily: Heads up — after yesterday's RBAC refactor a few customers on Dedicated/Private are reporting loss of admin access to the private control plane. Seems tied to new role -> aggregated-role mapping.

alex: which customers / envs?

emily: two dedicated tenants behind VPC allowlist, both in eu-west-1. Happened ~22:10 UTC last night. I saw KMS envelope decrypt logs delayed and some grant events missing from audit stream.

samir: saw a similar token bind fail in staging earlier today, looked like rolebindings were created but subjects empty.

emily: repro steps (short):
1) kube impersonate svcacct in private cp
2) call /admin/tenants list
3) 403 instead of 200

Commands I ran:
```
kubectl -n private-controlplane auth can-i --as=system:serviceaccount:tenant:admin get pods
kubectl get rolebinding -n private-controlplane | grep tenant-admin
```

devops-bot: Deploy 2026-02-28T22:03Z by mariadeploy (ref: rbac-refactor) linked to cluster private-eu-1. CI: #8146. :warning:

maria: I rolled out the aggregated mapping change. I didn't see failures in CI smoke, will dig.

alex: can you dump recent audit logs for that cluster? last 24h. Need to see create/update events for RoleBinding and any KMS decrypt/grant logs.

julian: grabbing logs now, might need to query both k8s audit and our forwarder (sumo). Running: `gcloud logging read "resource.labels.cluster_name=\"private-eu-1\"" --limit 500` then cross-check with `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes ...`

security-bot: Alert: missing `RoleBinding` create events between 2026-02-28T21:50 and 2026-02-28T22:20 for private-eu-1. Correlate with KMS decrypt latency spikes.

samir: quick mitigation for impacted tenants: revert aggregated mapping (PR rollback) or patch RoleBinding controller to backfill subjects. Which is faster?

emily: rollback seems fastest for production tenants. Maria can you cut rollback PR and trigger canary to dedicated-eu cluster only? We need a short mitigation window.

maria: rolling back now. Creating PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/controlplane/pull/942 (WIP). Triggering canary on private-eu-1 only.

alex: after rollback, re-run the audit queries and verify KMS decrypt events present. If audit still missing, suspect forwarder gap (sumo/forwarder).

julian: found an example audit snippet where subject list is empty: 
```
{"kind":"Event","timestamp":"2026-02-28T22:05:12Z","verb":"create","object":"rolebinding","object_name":"tenant-admin","user":"deploy-bot","user_info":{"username":"deploy-bot"},"subjects":[]}
```

emily: that explains 403s. Subjects empty => bindings exist but no principals. Why would our controller write empty subjects? Maria?

maria: controller fetches aggregated mapping from ConfigMap. I see a race where mapping was partially updated and a reconcile wrote an intermediate empty list. CI didn't catch because smoke used pre-existing mapping. I'll add a guard.

security-bot: Note: KMS decrypt backlog of ~30m correlated with deploy window. Investigating whether encrypt/decrypt callbacks caused controller to miss mapping payloads.

samir: action items:
- maria: revert PR + add guard + unit test (ETA 1h)
- julian: finish audit cross-check and export suspected incomplete events (ETA 30m)
- alex: notify SRE and create incident ticket if rollback doesn't fix within 15m (ETA now)
- emily: coordinate customer comms and postmortem (ETA EOD)

emily: temporary workaround for a tenant if rollback delayed: manually patch RoleBinding subjects for tenant-admin with `kubectl patch rolebinding tenant-admin -p '{"subjects":[{"kind":"ServiceAccount","name":"admin","namespace":"tenant"}]}'`

julian: audit cross-check shows rollback will restore subjects on newly reconciled bindings. Exported events into /tmp/rbac-missing-1766349820.log and uploaded to secure bucket.

maria: PR merged and canary applied to private-eu-1. Observing canary logs now.

devops-bot: Canary deployment for PR #942 succeeded on private-eu-1 at 2026-02-28T22:48Z.

alex: post-rollback quick checks:
- re-run `kubectl auth can-i` as tenant svcacct -> now returns yes.
- audit shows RoleBinding create with non-empty subjects.
- KMS decrypt backlog clearing, still monitoring.

emily: thanks all. Next steps: full rollout, formal postmortem, add telemetry to detect empty-subject writes, and KMS latency alerting. I'll open postmortem doc and assign owners. :white_check_mark:

samir: suggested postmortem fields: timeline, root cause (race in aggregated mapping update + controller reconcile), detection gap (missing alert on empty subjects), action items, follow-ups.

security-bot: Reminder: collect all related KMS request IDs and attach to incident for compliance.

emily: created incident INC-2026-082 and postmortem draft https://redwood-internal/docs/incidents/INC-2026-082. I'll follow up with customers asap.

alex: 👍 good work. Keep thread updated if any regressions.
